  </data>
  <data name="Text_1" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Hello! I am Pasi the Mage. Hahaha! Hmmm... The movement of the stars doesn't seem quite right. Your future... Hmm... I can't see your future either... Why's that...?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_2" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Hello! My name is Baz and I am the vault keeper. I can be of help to you wherever you go. Don't hesitate to leave your belongings with me.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_3" xml:space="preserve">

@B di 2501
    <value>Many adventurers have told me that the sound of the harp soothes and wipes away their fatigue. Do you need my help?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=3</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_4" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Hello! My name is Baz and I am the vault keeper. I can be of help to you wherever you go. Don't hesitate to leave your belongings with me.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=4</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_5" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Have you brought enough money? Without it, I can't combine the items because I need money to continue with my research. Understood? Do you want to know how much money is needed?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=5</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_6" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Welcome to MU! Press the F1 key if you need any assistance while traveling around the MU continent.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=6</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_7" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Is it your first time in Lorencia? Go to the southeast exit in front of the fountain and try to hunt Budge Dragons or Spiders. The Skeletons in Northwest are too dangerous.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=7</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_8" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Welcome to Noria. If it's your first time, pass through the vault guard and go to the south exit. Try to hunt low level monsters like Scorpions or Goblins.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=8</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_9" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>If you need a detailed guide of the MU continent check out http://muonline.webzen.net</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=9</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_50" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>The 'Scroll of the Emperor', which speaks of Muren, the first emperor of MU, is said to have been seen around the Lost Tower, Atlans, and the Dungeon.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=50</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_50_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I didn't know such a thing existed...</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1500</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_51" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Your offering to God isn't enough. I will tell you about the oracle if you make an offering of 1,000,000 Zen.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=51</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_51_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">

  <data name="Text_52" xml:space="preserve">

@B dj 868

  </data>
  <data name="Text_54" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Go find the 'Scroll of the Emperor'. You will be granted with great power upon reading it.</value>

  <data name="Text_55" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>You've found the 'Scroll of the Emperor'! The commemoration of unification of the Mu Empire's first emperor Muren was recorded with the power of magic here, you see. The one who possesses the 'Scroll of the Emperor' is granted with great power.</value>

@B dl 2561
    <value>Tell me about the record.</value>

  </data>
  <data name="Text_56" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>A historical record of the first emperor Muren contains the commemoration of peace through the triumph of Muren over all warlords and by doing so, unified the continent into the Empire or MU.</value>

  </data>
  <data name="Text_57" xml:space="preserve">

  <data name="Answer_57_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">

    <comment>legacy_id=1571</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_58" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Magical artifacts may be found and they are called the 'Broken Sword', 'Tear of Elf', and the 'Soul of Wizard'. The 'Broken Sword' was offered by the dark knights as a symbol of their bravery, loyalty and their wish for prosperity.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=58</comment>

  <data name="Answer_58_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Tell me the previous story.</value>

  <data name="Answer_58_Slot_1" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Please continue.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1581</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_59" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>The 'Soul of Wizard' was offered by the dark wizards as a symbol of their vow to use their power for the peace and freedom of the empire. Mu Year 10, an excerpt of the commemoration of peace record...</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=59</comment>

    <value>Tell me the previous story.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1590</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_59_Slot_1" xml:space="preserve">

    <comment>legacy_id=1591</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_60" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>If you've read the 'Scroll of the Emperor', seek out the 'Broken Sword' that the ancient dark knights used at the commemoration of peace. From what I've heard, a few dark knights have found it in Atlans, the Lost Tower and Tarkan.</value>

@B dm 1180

  </data>
  <data name="Text_65" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>That place is a very dangerous place and the 'Tear of Elf' is extremely hard to find. But if you find the 'Tear of Elf', new power will be bestowed upon you. Now, go find the 'Tear of Elf' and return to me.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=65</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_65_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value> I will go find the 'Tear of Elf'!</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1650</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_66" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>You've found the 'Tear of Elf'! After the War, Lunedil, the elf queen, created the tear stone by casting magic on the spirit stone so that elves could invoke the goddess' power and build their power.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=66</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_66_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Please continue.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1660</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_67" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>You've read the 'Scroll of the Emperor', haven't you. Then you must know about the 3 treasures recorded in it.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=67</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_67_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Please continue.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1670</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_68" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>With your power, I am sure that you will find the 'Soul of Wizard'. Now go find the 'Soul of Wizard' and return to me once you've found it.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=68</comment>

@B do 2274
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_68_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">

  </data>
  <data name="Text_69" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I knew you'd find the 'Soul of Wizard'! Etramu, the greatest wizard of Arka, created a soul-protecting magic stone, worried that the weak dark knights might falter at the attack of Kundun.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=69</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_69_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Please tell me more.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1690</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_70" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>A dark wizard with this magic stone becomes a soul master.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=70</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_70_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I am now a soul master!</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1700</comment>
  </data>

    <comment>legacy_id=1710</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_72" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>New power has been bestowed upon you as a result of your strong will and strength. May the grace of Lugard be with you at all times.</value>

  </data>

  <data name="Text_90" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>You've finished reading the 'Decree of the Emperor'. But do you know about the confidential contract between Muren and Semeden the leader summoner? Muren was promised of one thing instead of transferring Elbe to be under the empire.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=90</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_90_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1900</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_91" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>The Continent of MU had the gate of a dimension of the world under the supervision of the summoners. And Semeden had given the Abyss of Eye as a token of promise. Please go and bring back the Abyss of Eye.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=91</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_91_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Accept the request</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1910</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_91_Slot_1" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Deny the request</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1911</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_92" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I've heard that the Abyss of Eye was found around Atlance, Lost Tower and Tarkan. Come back with the Abyss of Eye as soon as you find it.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=92</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_92_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Finish telling the story</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1920</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_93" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>You've found the Abyss of Eye. This has been known as an object composed of the element inexistent in the real world. It's contagious from the world prior to the present, which the memory returns along with it.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=93</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_93_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1930</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_94" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Abyss of Eye holds a special meaning for me as I supervise and communicate through the dimensions of this world. If you bring back the Abyss of Eye, I will give you the Blood Summoner title for Semeden the supervisor of your dimension.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=94</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_94_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Imposition as the Blood Summoner</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=1940</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_100" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>The legendary treasure called 'Ring of Glory' is needed to acquire the blessing and strength of Muren. It has manifested its presence once more within our lands. But you are not ready. Wait until you are more experienced.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=100</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_100_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Then what do I need to do?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2000</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_101" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>More experience is required to survive this Quest. Return when you have gained up too 220 levels according to the trials of the lost empire.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=101</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_101_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I will return when my time has come.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2010</comment>
  </data>

  <data name="Text_109" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>This ring is said to revive life and grant perpetual youth. But it only works on heroes that possess the power to wield its strength.</value>

  </data>
  <data name="Answer_109_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Why's that?</value>

  </data>
  <data name="Text_110" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>It's because Etramu, the Wizard of Arka, cast a spell in order to prevent the evil from taking advantage of it. But the ring says you are fit for it.</value>

  <data name="Answer_110_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">

    <comment>legacy_id=2100</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_111" xml:space="preserve">

  </data>
  <data name="Answer_111_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">

    <comment>legacy_id=2110</comment>
  </data>

  <data name="Text_130" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>It indeed is the 'Ring of Glory'. Look at how it shines. This ring contains time and legend that you cannot even begin to fathom. It's a blessing that you have found it!.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=130</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_130_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I'm surprised to hear that!</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2300</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_131" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Yes, the ring is said to have the power to bring life to the dead and grant perpetual youth. It will only perform its best when it is in the hands of a true hero that can control the ring's power.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=131</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_131_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Why is that so?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2310</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_132" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>It is because Etramu, the Wizard of Arka, put a spell on it so that it doesn't fall into the hands of the wrong people. But it seems as though you are the right person!</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=132</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_132_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Is that so!</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2320</comment>
  </data>

    <comment>legacy_id=133</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_133_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Is that so!</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2330</comment>
  </data>

  </data>

  <data name="Answer_135_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">

@B dw 1992

  <data name="Text_136" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>With the 'Dark Stone', you can master a new ability. It won't be an easy task, but since you were able to acquire the 'Ring of Glory' it might be possible for you.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=136</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_136_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>What do I need to do?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2360</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_137" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Rumor has it that you can find the stone in Tarkan and Icarus. Be careful of the monsters. Those monsters that possess the stone will only react to those who have a special ability.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=137</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_137_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">

  </data>
  <data name="Text_138" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>The 'Dark Stone' is calling on you right now. With it in hand, you will surely acquire power that you have never felt before, but many other warriors are desperately in search of the stone as well.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=138</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_138_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">

  </data>
  <data name="Text_139" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>So you've found the 'Dark Stone. It is recorded that this stone is the dried up blood of the hero 'Benelope' who fought in the War of the Gods and Satan.</value>

  <data name="Answer_139_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Tell me more.</value>

@B dx 2590

  </data>
  <data name="Text_140" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Benelope is of a knight descent. After his defeat in the War, he trained for new magic and fighting skills. These skills have been silently initiated to warriors with the blood of a knight in order to fight against the powerful force of Kundun.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=140</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_140_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>So...</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2400</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_141" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Yes, the blood of a warrior runs through you. Thus, the power of Benelope will be granted to you through the Dark Stone.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=141</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_141_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I have been granted new power!</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2410</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_142" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>You have acquired new power through the 'Ring of Glory'. But there is something that you don't know.</value>

  </data>
  <data name="Answer_142_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>What is that?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2420</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_143" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>It is possible that you might be able to acquire new power. The legendary treasure called 'Dark Stone', which was considered sacred along with the 'Ring of Glory', is calling on you.</value>

  </data>
  <data name="Answer_143_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>That is hard to believe!</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2430</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_144" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Lugard the God of Light has requested a favor of you. However, you're still not qualified. I suggest you come back when you've become stronger.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=144</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_144_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I'll be back when I'm stronger.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2440</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_145" xml:space="preserve">
    <value> Lugard the God of Light has requested a favor of you. However, you're still not qualified. Please come back when you've completed the previous quest.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=145</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_145_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I'll come back when I've completed it.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2450</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_146" xml:space="preserve">

@B dy 1598
    <value>You do not have enough Zen. You may apply for this mission by offering 5,000,000 Zen to Lugard.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=146</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_146_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I'll come back when I am ready.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2460</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_147" xml:space="preserve">
    <value> Lugard the God of Light has requested a favor of you.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=147</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_147_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>What is it?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2470</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_148" xml:space="preserve">
    <value> Lugard has asked you to seek heroes to oppose Balgass' new threat to MU.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=148</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_148_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2480</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_149" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>We understand that Balgass' army's coming against the Continent of MU through the Cry Wolf Fortress, but there has not been an exact interpretation of the whole story.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=149</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_149_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2490</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_150" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>We're trying hard to understand the meaning of Lugar's trust towards us, but we still struggle to due to our inadequate ability.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=150</comment>

@B dz 1559
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_150_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2500</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_151" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I believe you are the people to offer us help. Are you interested in working with us?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=151</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_151_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Listen again.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2510</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_151_Slot_1" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Accept the request</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2511</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_151_Slot_2" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Deny the request</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2512</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_152" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>In order for you to help us, you must oppose Balgass' army. Before you begin, I need to check if you're adequately powerful for the mission.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=152</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_152_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2520</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_153" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Destroy Death Beam, Hellmaine and Dark Phoenix monsters which dominate over Tarkan, Aida and Icarus and bring back 3 pieces of evidence accordingly.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=153</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_153_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Finish telling the story</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2530</comment>

@B e0 1684
  </data>
  <data name="Text_154" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Congratulations, you've completed the duty. Here's a small something for your hard work.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=154</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_154_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2540</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_155" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Balgass is a great threat as he is since he's in cooperation with Eresia the Queen of Sorcery and has brought such danger into this world</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=155</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_155_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2550</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_156" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>We predict that Balgass is attempting a new threat against the Continent of MU with his army of evil sorcery.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=156</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_156_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Finish telling the story</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2560</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_157" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>You don't have enough fund. Please offer 7,000,000 Zen to Lugard to apply for this mission.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=157</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_157_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I'll come back when I am ready.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2570</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_158" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Welcome, you are truly ready to help us now.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=158</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_158_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">

@B e1 556
    <value>What do you need help with?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2580</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_159" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Well, according to our information Balgass has formed a locations called the Barracks. The 12 apostles of Lugard believe that this is a new threat from Balgass.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=159</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_159_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2590</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_160" xml:space="preserve">

@B e2 2516
    <value>Exact information about the 'Barrack' drives one to enter the Barrack zone to diminish the threat of the further development of Balgass' army.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=160</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_160_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2600</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_161" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Fortunately Lugar's guardianship could help find the way to enter Balgass' Barrack. Enter the zone, destroy the soldiers and gain accurate information. Will you bring back the proper data accordingly?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=161</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_161_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Listen again.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2610</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_161_Slot_1" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Accept the request</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2611</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_161_Slot_2" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Deny the request</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2612</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_162" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Go to the northern graveyard of Cry Wolf zone and find the soldier refuge from Balgass' Barrack. Lugar's blessing has caused one to have intelligence. He calls himself, Werewolf Guardsman.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=162</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_162_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2620</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_163" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>He will lead you to Balgass' Barrack. Enter the zone and destroy minimum 10 monsters in the Barrack.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=163</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_163_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Finish telling the story</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2630</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_164" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>You've safely completed the duty I appreciate your hard work and the strong will.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=164</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_164_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue talking.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2640</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_165" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>You have brought great help to build peace to the Continent of MU and Cry Wolf with the information and all the destroyed monsters.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=165</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_165_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">

@B e3 1323
    <value>Finish telling the story</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2650</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_166" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>You are not qualified yet. Visit Security Guard Mallon, and come back when you are fully qualified for the mission.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=166</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_166_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Finish the story.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2660</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_167" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>You don't have enough fund. Please offer 10,000,000 Zen to Lugard to apply for this mission.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=167</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_167_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>I'll come back when I am ready.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2670</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_168" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Your initiative courage has shown a great hope to us all.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=168</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_168_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2680</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_169" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Balgass has hidden himself in a separate place to restore himself from the tiresome body.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=169</comment>

@B e4 2299
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_169_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2690</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_170" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>In order to follow Lugar's entrusted mission, Balgass' exact location must be found and the army in training destroyed.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=170</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_170_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2700</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_171" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>The final mission to follow after Lugar's mission includes a huge and difficult test. Are you still interested?</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=171</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_171_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Listen again.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2710</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_171_Slot_1" xml:space="preserve">

    <comment>legacy_id=2711</comment>

  <data name="Answer_171_Slot_2" xml:space="preserve">

    <comment>legacy_id=2712</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_172" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Enter inside through the door at the northern edge of Balgass' Barrack; We will have the place ready beforehand.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=172</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_172_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Finish telling the story</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2720</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_173" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Congratulations, you've passed Lugar's final test. And now his blessing will be with you wherever you go.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=173</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_173_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Continue listening.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2730</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Text_174" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Your hard work has paid off to keep peace in the Continent of MU and Cry Wolf from Balgass' new threat. I deeply appreciate your help.</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=174</comment>
  </data>
  <data name="Answer_174_Slot_0" xml:space="preserve">
    <value>Finish telling the story</value>
    <comment>legacy_id=2740</comment>

    "RenaIsATypeOfGold": "“瑞纳”是奇迹大陆诞生以前由天界使用的一种金币。把瑞纳交给勇者大陆前的黄金弓箭手，即可获得陆迦德祝福号码。",
    "YouVeBrought10RenaAs": "你带来了 10 个瑞纳。作为谢礼，我来告诉你瑞纳的来历。瑞纳由奇迹大陆不存在的金色金属制成，学者们研究后确认它来自天界。",
    "RenaEmbodiesAVeryStrongPower": "瑞纳蕴含着强大的魔力。据说古代魔法师会用它施展强力魔法。古代最伟大的魔法师艾特拉穆研究天界时，用偶然发现的瑞纳创造了坚不可摧的魔法金属“西克罗米康”。",
    "BeforeKundunFindsRenaHiddenIn": "必须赶在昆顿之前找到藏在奇迹大陆各处的瑞纳，查明它的秘密和力量来源。",
    "Bring Rena from the box of heaven.": "请从天界之盒中取得瑞纳。",
    "When you bring 10 Rena, you will be given a number blessed by Lugard.": "带来 10 个瑞纳，即可获得陆迦德祝福号码。",
    "AreYouThrowingRenaOnThe": "要把瑞纳扔到地上吗？瑞纳在这个世界或许没有其他用途，但可以在黄金弓箭手处兑换成金币。",
    "RenaIsATypeOfCoin": "“瑞纳”是很久以前天界使用的一种金币。它无法在这个世界直接使用，但可以在勇者大陆的黄金弓箭手处兑换成金币。",

    "AfterThenScholarsOfMUStudying": "此后，奇迹大陆的学者通过研究艾特拉穆的成果，确认天界确实存在，并尝试借助瑞纳揭开天界的秘密。",

  "Dialog": {

@B 1rwo 677
    "Text_0": "嗯！有什么需要吗？",
    "Text_1": "你好！我是魔导师帕西。哈哈哈！嗯……星象似乎有些异常。你的未来……嗯……我竟然也看不清。为什么会这样……？",
    "Text_2": "你好！我是仓库管理员巴兹。无论你走到哪里，我都能为你保管物品。放心把东西交给我吧。",
    "Text_3": "许多冒险者都说，竖琴声能抚慰心灵、消除疲劳。需要我的帮助吗？",
    "Text_4": "你好！我是仓库管理员巴兹。无论你走到哪里，我都能为你保管物品。放心把东西交给我吧。",
    "Text_5": "带够钱了吗？我的研究需要经费，没有足够的金币就无法合成物品。明白了吗？想知道需要多少钱吗？",
    "Text_6": "欢迎来到奇迹大陆！旅途中需要帮助时，请按 F1 键查看说明。",
    "Text_7": "第一次来到勇者大陆吗？从喷泉前的东南出口出去，可以先狩猎幼龙或蜘蛛。西北方向的骷髅兵对你来说太危险了。",
    "Text_8": "欢迎来到仙踪林。第一次来这里的话，经过仓库守卫后从南门出去，先狩猎蝎子或哥布林等低级怪物吧。",
    "Text_9": "需要奇迹大陆的详细指南时，请访问 http://muonline.webzen.net",
    "Text_50": "据说记载奇迹大陆第一位皇帝穆伦事迹的“帝王之书”，曾在失落之塔、亚特兰蒂斯和地下城一带出现。",
    "Answer_50_Slot_0": "我从来不知道还有这样的东西……",

@B 1rwp 1773
    "Text_51": "你献给神的贡金还不够。献上 1,000,000 金币，我就把神谕告诉你。",
    "Answer_51_Slot_0": "我会带着 1,000,000 金币回来。",
    "Text_52": "据说记载奇迹大陆统一者、第一位皇帝穆伦事迹的“帝王之书”，曾在失落之塔、亚特兰蒂斯和地下城一带出现。",
    "Answer_52_Slot_0": "请再多告诉我一些。",
    "Text_53": "“帝王之书”被强大的力量环绕。任何读过它的人，都将得到这股力量的祝福。",
    "Answer_53_Slot_0": "请再讲一遍。",
    "Answer_53_Slot_1": "我去找它。",
    "Answer_53_Slot_2": "我不感兴趣。",
    "Text_54": "去寻找“帝王之书”吧。读过它之后，你将获得强大的力量。",
    "Answer_54_Slot_0": "我去找它。",
    "Text_55": "你找到了“帝王之书”！这里用魔法记录着奇迹帝国第一位皇帝穆伦统一大陆的功绩。拥有“帝王之书”的人将获得强大的力量。",
    "Answer_55_Slot_0": "请告诉我书中的记载。",
    "Text_56": "第一位皇帝穆伦击败各地军阀，结束战争、统一大陆并建立奇迹帝国。这本史书正是为了纪念他带来的和平。",
    "Answer_56_Slot_0": "请继续说。",
    "Text_57": "瑟克尼姆入侵大陆、百姓陷入混乱时，穆伦正是终结乱世的三位英雄之一。",
    "Answer_57_Slot_0": "请讲讲前面的故事。",
    "Answer_57_Slot_1": "请继续说。",
    "Text_58": "书中还记载了三件魔法信物：“断魂之剑”“精灵之泪”和“先知之魂”。“断魂之剑”由剑士们献上，象征他们的勇气、忠诚以及对繁荣的愿望。",
    "Answer_58_Slot_0": "请讲讲前面的故事。",
    "Answer_58_Slot_1": "请继续说。",
    "Text_59": "“先知之魂”由魔法师们献上，象征他们立誓为帝国的和平与自由使用力量。奇迹历 10 年，《和平纪念录》节选……",
    "Answer_59_Slot_0": "请讲讲前面的故事。",
    "Answer_59_Slot_1": "原来是这样……",
    "Text_60": "既然你已经读过“帝王之书”，就去寻找古代剑士在和平庆典上使用过的“断魂之剑”吧。听说有人曾在亚特兰蒂斯、失落之塔和死亡沙漠找到它。",
    "Answer_60_Slot_0": "我会找到它。",
    "Answer_60_Slot_1": "我放弃。",
    "Text_61": "那些地方处处潜藏危险，“断魂之剑”也很难被发现。不过只要找到它，你就会获得新的力量！找到后再来见我。",
    "Answer_61_Slot_0": "我一定会把它带回来。",
    "Text_62": "勇敢的剑士，你找到了“断魂之剑”！奇迹大陆统一后，第一位皇帝穆伦折断自己的宝剑“末日”，以此表达不愿战争再次发生的心愿。",
    "Answer_62_Slot_0": "请再多告诉我一些。",
    "Text_63": "战争结束后，想要成为骑士的剑士开始寻找古代的“断魂之剑”，以此证明自己的勇气。",
    "Answer_63_Slot_0": "原来是这样！",
    "Text_64": "你已经读过“帝王之书”了吧？那么你应该知道书中记载的三件宝物。去寻找古代精灵用灵魂之力制成的水晶“精灵之泪”吧。",
    "Answer_64_Slot_0": "请再多告诉我一些。",
    "Text_65": "那里非常危险，“精灵之泪”也极难找到。不过只要找到它，你就会获得新的力量。现在去寻找“精灵之泪”，找到后再回来见我。",
    "Answer_65_Slot_0": "我这就去寻找“精灵之泪”！",

@B 1rwq 861
    "Text_66": "你找到了“精灵之泪”！战争结束后，精灵女王露内迪尔对灵魂之石施加魔法，制成这颗泪石，让精灵能够召唤女神之力并增强自身力量。",
    "Answer_66_Slot_0": "请继续说。",
    "Text_67": "你已经读过“帝王之书”了吧？那么你应该知道书中记载的三件宝物。",
    "Answer_67_Slot_0": "请继续说。",
    "Text_68": "凭你的力量，一定能找到“先知之魂”。现在就去寻找它，找到后再回来见我。",
    "Answer_68_Slot_0": "我去寻找“先知之魂”。",
    "Text_69": "我就知道你能找到“先知之魂”！阿卡最伟大的魔法师艾特拉穆担心力量薄弱的魔法师会在昆顿的攻击下动摇，因此创造了这块守护灵魂的魔法石。",
    "Answer_69_Slot_0": "请再多告诉我一些。",
    "Text_70": "拥有这块魔法石的魔法师，将成为魔导师。",
    "Answer_70_Slot_0": "我现在是魔导师了！",
    "Text_71": "你献给神的贡金还不够。献上 2,000,000 金币，我就把神谕告诉你。",
    "Answer_71_Slot_0": "我会带着 2,000,000 金币回来。",
    "Text_72": "你的坚强意志和实力为你赢得了新的力量。愿陆迦德的恩典永远与你同在。",
    "Answer_72_Slot_0": "愿神的恩典与我同在……",
    "Text_73": "你已经拥有强大的力量，我没有新的神谕可以告诉你。",
    "Answer_73_Slot_0": "我以后再来。",
    "Text_74": "等你变得更强之后再来吧。",
    "Answer_74_Slot_0": "等我变强后再回来。",
    "Text_75": "只要成长为强大的战士，你就能找到它。",

@B 1rwr 753
    "Answer_75_Slot_0": "请继续说。",
    "Text_76": "从那以后，想成为骑士的剑士都会折断自己的剑，以此立誓绝不为非正义之事挥剑，这也逐渐成为一种传统。",
    "Answer_76_Slot_0": "请再多告诉我一些。",
    "Text_77": "一些富有冒险精神的精灵说，他们曾在失落之塔、亚特兰蒂斯和死亡沙漠见过它。",
    "Answer_77_Slot_0": "我去找它！",
    "Answer_77_Slot_1": "我不想去那么危险的地方。",
    "Text_78": "这就是“精灵之泪”。找到这块宝石的弓箭手将成为圣射手，并能召唤精灵女神的力量。",
    "Answer_78_Slot_0": "我成为圣射手了！",
    "Text_79": "你已经找到“帝王之书”和“断魂之剑”，从现在起，你将被称为骑士。",
    "Answer_79_Slot_0": "我成为骑士了！",
    "Text_80": "帝国统一后，人们向皇帝宣誓效忠。下面这些宝物，就是当时献上的忠诚信物。",
    "Answer_80_Slot_0": "请讲讲前面的故事。",
    "Answer_80_Slot_1": "请继续说。",
    "Text_81": "“精灵之泪”由精灵们献上，象征他们立誓增强精灵与人类的力量。",
    "Answer_81_Slot_0": "请讲讲前面的故事。",
    "Answer_81_Slot_1": "请继续说。",
    "Text_82": "去寻找“先知之魂”吧。据古代魔法师所说，它最后一次出现在失落之塔、亚特兰蒂斯和死亡沙漠一带。",

@B 1rws 513
    "Answer_82_Slot_0": "我去找它。",
    "Answer_82_Slot_1": "我以后再来。",
    "Text_90": "你已经读完“帝王之书”。不过，你知道穆伦与召唤术师首领塞梅丹之间的秘密契约吗？穆伦把艾尔贝纳入帝国版图时，曾向塞梅丹许下一个承诺。",
    "Answer_90_Slot_0": "继续听。",
    "Text_91": "召唤术师曾负责看守连接奇迹大陆与异界的次元之门，塞梅丹则以“深渊之眼”作为约定的信物。请去把“深渊之眼”带回来。",
    "Answer_91_Slot_0": "接受任务",
    "Answer_91_Slot_1": "拒绝任务",
    "Text_92": "听说“深渊之眼”曾在亚特兰蒂斯、失落之塔和死亡沙漠一带出现。找到后尽快把它带回来。",
    "Answer_92_Slot_0": "结束对话",
    "Text_93": "你找到了“深渊之眼”。它由现实世界中不存在的元素构成，来自过去的异界，同时承载着那个世界的记忆。",
    "Answer_93_Slot_0": "继续听。",

@B 1rwt 2137
    "Text_94": "我负责监视各个次元并与异界沟通，因此“深渊之眼”对我有特殊意义。把它交给我，我将以次元守护者塞梅丹之名授予你召唤导师的称号。",
    "Answer_94_Slot_0": "晋升为召唤导师",
    "Text_100": "若想获得穆伦的祝福与力量，就需要传说中的宝物“荣誉戒指”。它再次出现在这片大陆上，但你还没有准备好。等你拥有更多历练后再来吧。",
    "Answer_100_Slot_0": "那我需要做什么？",
    "Text_101": "这项任务需要更丰富的经验才能完成。按照失落帝国的试炼，等你达到 220 级后再回来。",
    "Answer_101_Slot_0": "时机成熟后我会回来。",
    "Text_102": "若想获得穆伦的祝福与力量，就需要传说中的宝物“荣誉戒指”。它再次出现在这片大陆上。",
    "Answer_102_Slot_0": "我想听听详情。",
    "Text_103": "拥有“荣誉戒指”的人将得到穆伦的祝福。据说它出现在大海彼岸的沙漠中。",
    "Answer_103_Slot_0": "为什么会在那里？",
    "Text_104": "那里的怪物非常强大，戒指就在它们手中。",
    "Answer_104_Slot_0": "请再讲一遍。",
    "Answer_104_Slot_1": "我去试试。",
    "Answer_104_Slot_2": "我还没准备好。",
    "Text_105": "“荣誉戒指”出现的地方可能比你想象中更近。得到它后，你一定会感受到力量的变化，不过这绝非易事。",
    "Answer_105_Slot_0": "我会把它带回来。",
    "Text_108": "这确实是“荣誉戒指”。它散发着比我想象中更神秘的光芒。这枚戒指承载着你无法想象的悠久传说，能得到它是你的福分。",
    "Answer_108_Slot_0": "原来如此。",
    "Text_109": "据说这枚戒指能令生命复苏、让人青春永驻。不过，只有真正能驾驭它力量的英雄才能发挥其作用。",
    "Answer_109_Slot_0": "为什么？",
    "Text_110": "因为阿卡的魔法师艾特拉穆施加了法术，防止邪恶之人利用戒指。不过戒指已经认定你有资格驾驭它。",
    "Answer_110_Slot_0": "是这样吗？",
    "Text_111": "“荣誉戒指”与预言书《西克罗米康》一同用不朽金属制成，两者一直被奉为圣物。副指挥官盖恩发动叛乱并将它们夺走后，其下落便无人知晓。",
    "Answer_111_Slot_0": "竟然是这样？！",
    "Text_112": "如今“荣誉戒指”已经重现，你将能够成长为更强大的战士。",
    "Answer_112_Slot_0": "我能感觉到自己的能力正在提升！",
    "Text_113": "你将成长为远胜从前的强者。请把这份力量用于守护帝国的和平。",
    "Answer_113_Slot_0": "我会的。",
    "Text_114": "你已经拥有神圣的力量。",
    "Answer_114_Slot_0": "我以后再来。",
    "Text_115": "据说能赋予战士新力量的“暗黑之石”已经出现在奇迹大陆。不过你还没有准备好驾驭这股力量，准备充分后再来吧。",
    "Answer_115_Slot_0": "准备好后我会回来。",
    "Text_116": "若想获得完整的力量，你必须先找到记录穆伦皇帝历史的“帝王之书”并完成准备。去冰风谷找圣导士赛维娜吧。",
    "Answer_116_Slot_0": "准备好后我会回来。",
    "Text_117": "你还无法成为骑士。先通过“荣誉戒指”获得新的力量，再回来吧。",
    "Answer_117_Slot_0": "准备好后我会回来。",
    "Text_118": "要让神圣化这项任务，你必须献上 3,000,000 金币。你的金币还不够。",
    "Answer_118_Slot_0": "我会带着 3,000,000 金币回来。",
    "Text_119": "你献给神的贡金还不够。献上 2,000,000 金币，我就把神谕告诉你。",
    "Answer_119_Slot_0": "我会带着 2,000,000 金币回来。",
    "Text_130": "这确实是“荣誉戒指”。看它闪耀的光芒！这枚戒指承载着你无法想象的悠久岁月与传说。能找到它，是你的福分！",
    "Answer_130_Slot_0": "没想到还有这样的传说！",
    "Text_131": "没错，据说这枚戒指能令死者复生、让人青春永驻。不过，只有真正能够掌控戒指力量的英雄才能发挥它的全部威力。",

@B 1rwu 659
    "Answer_131_Slot_0": "为什么会这样？",
    "Text_132": "因为阿卡的魔法师艾特拉穆对它施加了法术，以免戒指落入歹人之手。现在看来，你正是合适的人选！",
    "Answer_132_Slot_0": "是这样吗！",
    "Text_133": "“荣誉戒指”与预言书《西克罗米康》一同用不朽金属制成，两者一直被奉为圣物。副指挥官盖恩发动叛乱并将它们夺走后，其下落便无人知晓。",
    "Answer_133_Slot_0": "竟然是这样！",
    "Text_134": "如今“荣誉戒指”已经重现，你将能够成长为更强大的战士。",
    "Answer_134_Slot_0": "我能感觉到自己的能力正在提升！",
    "Text_135": "如果想获得新的力量，就仔细听我说。据说能赋予战士新力量的“暗黑之石”已经出现在奇迹大陆。",
    "Answer_135_Slot_0": "我想听听详情。",
    "Text_136": "拥有“暗黑之石”，你就能掌握新的能力。这绝非易事，不过既然你能取得“荣誉戒指”，也一定有机会找到它。",
    "Answer_136_Slot_0": "我需要做什么？",
    "Text_137": "传闻在死亡沙漠和天空之城能找到这块石头。务必小心那里的怪物，持有石头的怪物只会对拥有特殊能力的人作出反应。",
    "Answer_137_Slot_0": "请再讲一遍。",

@B 1rwv 2876
    "Answer_137_Slot_1": "那我去试试！",
    "Answer_137_Slot_2": "我还没有信心。",
    "Text_138": "“暗黑之石”此刻正呼唤着你。只要将它握在手中，你必定能获得从未感受过的力量。不过，还有许多战士也在拼命寻找它。",
    "Answer_138_Slot_0": "我会带着“暗黑之石”回来。",
    "Text_139": "看来你找到了“暗黑之石”。据记载，这块石头是英雄贝内洛普在神魔战争中奋战时流下并凝固的鲜血。",
    "Answer_139_Slot_0": "请再多告诉我一些。",
    "Text_140": "贝内洛普出身骑士世家。战败后，他潜心修炼新的魔法和战斗技巧。为了对抗昆顿的强大势力，这些技巧一直秘密传授给继承骑士血脉的战士。",
    "Answer_140_Slot_0": "原来如此……",
    "Text_141": "没错，战士的血脉正在你体内流淌。因此，贝内洛普的力量将通过“暗黑之石”传给你。",
    "Answer_141_Slot_0": "我获得了新的力量！",
    "Text_142": "你已经通过“荣誉戒指”获得了新的力量，但还有一件事你并不知道。",
    "Answer_142_Slot_0": "是什么事？",
    "Text_143": "你也许还能获得另一种新力量。与“荣誉戒指”一同被奉为圣物的传说宝物“暗黑之石”，正在呼唤着你。",
    "Answer_143_Slot_0": "真让人难以置信！",
    "Text_144": "光明之神陆迦德有事委托你，不过你现在还不够资格。等你变得更强后再来吧。",
    "Answer_144_Slot_0": "等我变强后再回来。",
    "Text_145": "光明之神陆迦德有事委托你，不过你现在还不够资格。请先完成之前的任务，再回来见我。",
    "Answer_145_Slot_0": "完成任务后我会回来。",
    "Text_146": "你的金币不够。向陆迦德献上 5,000,000 金币，才能申请这项任务。",
    "Answer_146_Slot_0": "准备好后我会回来。",
    "Text_147": "光明之神陆迦德有事委托你。",
    "Answer_147_Slot_0": "是什么事？",
    "Text_148": "陆迦德希望你寻找英雄，一同抵御巴卡斯给奇迹大陆带来的新威胁。",
    "Answer_148_Slot_0": "继续听。",
    "Text_149": "我们知道巴卡斯的军队正试图通过狼魂要塞进攻奇迹大陆，但目前还无法完全掌握事情的全貌。",
    "Answer_149_Slot_0": "继续听。",
    "Text_150": "我们一直努力理解陆迦德托付给我们的使命，但由于能力不足，至今仍未能参透其中的全部含义。",
    "Answer_150_Slot_0": "继续听。",
    "Text_151": "我相信你正是能够帮助我们的人。愿意与我们并肩作战吗？",
    "Answer_151_Slot_0": "再听一遍。",
    "Answer_151_Slot_1": "接受任务",
    "Answer_151_Slot_2": "拒绝任务",
    "Text_152": "要帮助我们，你就必须与巴卡斯军团为敌。行动之前，我需要确认你是否拥有完成任务所需的力量。",
    "Answer_152_Slot_0": "继续听。",
    "Text_153": "击败盘踞在死亡沙漠、幽暗森林和天空之城的炽炎魔、丛林召唤者与天魔菲尼斯，并分别带回三件强者的证明。",
    "Answer_153_Slot_0": "结束对话",
    "Text_154": "恭喜你完成任务。这份小小的奖励，是对你辛劳的谢意。",
    "Answer_154_Slot_0": "继续听。",
    "Text_155": "巴卡斯与魔界女王艾丽丝迦联手，给这个世界带来了巨大的危险，因此他本身就是极其严重的威胁。",
    "Answer_155_Slot_0": "继续听。",
    "Text_156": "我们推测，巴卡斯正准备率领邪恶魔法军团，再次威胁奇迹大陆。",
    "Answer_156_Slot_0": "结束对话",
    "Text_157": "你的金币不够。向陆迦德献上 7,000,000 金币，才能申请这项任务。",
    "Answer_157_Slot_0": "准备好后我会回来。",
    "Text_158": "欢迎回来。现在你确实已经拥有帮助我们的力量。",
    "Answer_158_Slot_0": "需要我做什么？",
    "Text_159": "根据情报，巴卡斯建立了一处名为“巴卡斯兵营”的据点。陆迦德的十二使徒认为，这是巴卡斯带来的新威胁。",
    "Answer_159_Slot_0": "继续听。",
    "Text_160": "为了查明“巴卡斯兵营”的确切情况，必须潜入兵营，削弱巴卡斯正在扩张的军力。",
    "Answer_160_Slot_0": "继续听。",
    "Text_161": "幸运的是，陆迦德的守护能帮助你找到进入巴卡斯兵营的道路。潜入那里，消灭训练兵并取得准确情报。你愿意把调查结果带回来吗？",
    "Answer_161_Slot_0": "再听一遍。",
    "Answer_161_Slot_1": "接受任务",
    "Answer_161_Slot_2": "拒绝任务",
    "Text_162": "前往狼魂要塞北部的墓地，寻找从巴卡斯兵营逃出的士兵。陆迦德的祝福让他恢复了灵智，他自称“暗黑血狼人扩雷”。",
    "Answer_162_Slot_0": "继续听。",

/**
 * # CategoryJoystick
 *
 * SDL joystick support.
 *
 * This is the lower-level joystick handling. If you want the simpler option,
 * where what each button does is well-defined, you should use the gamepad API
 * instead.
 *
 * The term "instance_id" is the current instantiation of a joystick device in
 * the system. If the joystick is removed and then re-inserted then it will
 * get a new instance_id. instance_id's are monotonically increasing
 * identifiers of a joystick plugged in.

@B 55y 713
 *
 * The term "player_index" is the number assigned to a player on a specific
 * controller. For XInput controllers this returns the XInput user index. Many
 * joysticks will not be able to supply this information.
 *
 * SDL_GUID is used as a stable 128-bit identifier for a joystick device that
 * does not change over time. It identifies class of the device (a X360 wired
 * controller for example). This identifier is platform dependent.
 *
 * In order to use these functions, SDL_Init() must have been called with the
 * SDL_INIT_JOYSTICK flag. This causes SDL to scan the system for joysticks,
 * and load appropriate drivers.
 *
 * If you would like to receive joystick updates while the application is in

@B 55z 636
 * the background, you should set the following hint before calling
 * SDL_Init(): SDL_HINT_JOYSTICK_ALLOW_BACKGROUND_EVENTS
 *
 * SDL can provide virtual joysticks as well: the app defines an imaginary
 * controller with SDL_AttachVirtualJoystick(), and then can provide inputs
 * for it via SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(), SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(),
 * etc. As this data is supplied, it will look like a normal joystick to SDL,
 * just not backed by a hardware driver. This has been used to make unusual
 * devices, like VR headset controllers, look like normal joysticks, or
 * provide recording/playback of game inputs, etc.
 */

@B 560 634

typedef struct SDL_Joystick SDL_Joystick;

/* number of seconds in 400 days */
#define COOKIES_MAXAGE (400 * 24 * 3600)

/* Make sure cookies never expire further away in time than 400 days into the
   future. (from RFC6265bis draft-19)

   For the sake of easier testing, align the capped time to an even 60 second
   boundary. */

@B 1422 1464
static void cap_expires(time_t now, struct Cookie *co)
{
  if(co->expires && (TIME_T_MAX - COOKIES_MAXAGE - 30) > now) {
    timediff_t cap = now + COOKIES_MAXAGE;
    if(co->expires > cap) {
      cap += 30;
      co->expires = (cap / 60) * 60;
    }
  }
}

    curlx_free(co);
}

static bool cookie_tailmatch(const char *cookie_domain,
                             const size_t cookie_domain_len,
                             const char *hostname)
{
  size_t hostname_len = strlen(hostname);

  if(hostname_len < cookie_domain_len)
    return FALSE;

  if(!curl_strnequal(cookie_domain,
                     hostname + hostname_len - cookie_domain_len,
                     cookie_domain_len))
    return FALSE;

  /*
   * A lead char of cookie_domain is not '.'.
   * RFC6265 4.1.2.3. The Domain Attribute says:
   * For example, if the value of the Domain attribute is
   * "example.com", the user agent will include the cookie in the Cookie
   * header when making HTTP requests to example.com, www.example.com, and
   * www.corp.example.com.
   */
  if(hostname_len == cookie_domain_len)
    return TRUE;
  if('.' == *(hostname + hostname_len - cookie_domain_len - 1))
    return TRUE;
  return FALSE;
}

/*
 * matching cookie path and URL path
 * RFC6265 5.1.4 Paths and Path-Match
 */

@B 1423 1423
static bool pathmatch(const char *cookie_path, const char *uri_path)
{
  size_t cookie_path_len;
  size_t uri_path_len;
  bool ret = FALSE;

  /* cookie_path must not have last '/' separator. ex: /sample */
  cookie_path_len = strlen(cookie_path);
  if(cookie_path_len == 1) {
    /* cookie_path must be '/' */
    return TRUE;
  }

  /* #-fragments are already cut off! */
  if(strlen(uri_path) == 0 || uri_path[0] != '/')
    uri_path = "/";

  /*
   * here, RFC6265 5.1.4 says
   *  4. Output the characters of the uri-path from the first character up
   *     to, but not including, the right-most %x2F ("/").
   *  but URL path /hoge?fuga=xxx means /hoge/index.cgi?fuga=xxx in some site
   *  without redirect.
   *  Ignore this algorithm because /hoge is uri path for this case
   *  (uri path is not /).
   */

  uri_path_len = strlen(uri_path);

  if(uri_path_len < cookie_path_len)
    goto pathmatched;

  /* not using checkprefix() because matching should be case-sensitive */
  if(strncmp(cookie_path, uri_path, cookie_path_len))
    goto pathmatched;

  /* The cookie-path and the uri-path are identical. */
  if(cookie_path_len == uri_path_len) {
    ret = TRUE;
    goto pathmatched;
  }

  /* here, cookie_path_len < uri_path_len */
  if(uri_path[cookie_path_len] == '/') {
    ret = TRUE;
    goto pathmatched;
  }

pathmatched:
  return ret;
}

/*
 * Return the top-level domain, for optimal hashing.
 */

@B 1424 598
static const char *get_top_domain(const char * const domain, size_t *outlen)
{
  size_t len = 0;
  const char *first = NULL, *last;

  if(domain) {
    len = strlen(domain);
    last = memrchr(domain, '.', len);
    if(last) {
      first = memrchr(domain, '.', (last - domain));
      if(first)
        len -= (++first - domain);
    }
  }

  if(outlen)
    *outlen = len;

  return first ? first : domain;
}

/*
 * A case-insensitive hash for the cookie domains.
 */

@B 1425 636
static size_t cookie_hash_domain(const char *domain, const size_t len)
{
  const char *end = domain + len;
  size_t h = 5381;

  while(domain < end) {
    size_t j = (size_t)Curl_raw_toupper(*domain++);
    h += h << 5;
    h ^= j;
  }

  return (h % COOKIE_HASH_SIZE);
}

#if defined(_MSC_VER) && (_MSC_VER == 1900)
#pragma optimize("", on)
#endif

/*
 * Hash this domain.
 */
static size_t cookiehash(const char * const domain)
{
  const char *top;
  size_t len;

  if(!domain || Curl_host_is_ipnum(domain))
    return 0;

  top = get_top_domain(domain, &len);
  return cookie_hash_domain(top, len);
}

/*

@B 1426 667
static char *sanitize_cookie_path(const char *cookie_path, size_t len)
{
  /* some sites send path attribute within '"'. */
  if(len && (cookie_path[0] == '\"')) {
    cookie_path++;
    len--;

    if(len && (cookie_path[len - 1] == '\"'))
      len--;

  /* RFC6265 5.2.4 The Path Attribute */
  if(!len || (cookie_path[0] != '/'))
    /* Let cookie-path be the default-path. */
    return curlx_strdup("/");

  /* remove trailing slash when path is non-empty */
  /* convert /hoge/ to /hoge */
  if(len > 1 && cookie_path[len - 1] == '/')
    len--;

  return curlx_memdup0(cookie_path, len);
}

 * A thin wrapper around curlx_memdup0().

static CURLcode strstore(char **str, const char *newstr, size_t len)
{

  if(!*str)
    return CURLE_OUT_OF_MEMORY;
  return CURLE_OK;
}

/*
 * remove_expired
 *
 * Remove expired cookies from the hash by inspecting the expires timestamp on
 * each cookie in the hash, freeing and deleting any where the timestamp is in
 * the past. If the cookiejar has recorded the next timestamp at which one or
 * more cookies expire, then processing will exit early in case this timestamp
 * is in the future.
 */

@B 1428 1359
static void remove_expired(struct CookieInfo *ci)
{
  struct Cookie *co;
  curl_off_t now = (curl_off_t)time(NULL);
  unsigned int i;

  /*
   * If the earliest expiration timestamp in the jar is in the future we can
   * skip scanning the whole jar and instead exit early as there will not be
   * any cookies to evict. If we need to evict, reset the next_expiration
   * counter in order to track the next one. In case the recorded first
   * expiration is the max offset, then perform the safe fallback of checking
   * all cookies.
   */
  if(now < ci->next_expiration &&
     ci->next_expiration != CURL_OFF_T_MAX)
    return;
  else
    ci->next_expiration = CURL_OFF_T_MAX;

  for(i = 0; i < COOKIE_HASH_SIZE; i++) {
    struct Curl_llist_node *n;
    struct Curl_llist_node *e = NULL;

    for(n = Curl_llist_head(&ci->cookielist[i]); n; n = e) {
      co = Curl_node_elem(n);
      e = Curl_node_next(n);
      if(co->expires) {
        if(co->expires < now) {
          Curl_node_remove(n);
          freecookie(co, TRUE);
          ci->numcookies--;
        }
        else if(co->expires < ci->next_expiration)
          /*
           * If this cookie has an expiration timestamp earlier than what we
           * have seen so far then record it for the next round of expirations.
           */
          ci->next_expiration = co->expires;
      }

@B 1429 875
    }
  }
}

#ifndef USE_LIBPSL
/* Make sure domain contains a dot or is localhost. */
static bool bad_domain(const char *domain, size_t len)
{
  if((len == 9) && curl_strnequal(domain, "localhost", 9))
    return FALSE;
  else {
    /* there must be a dot present, but that dot must not be a trailing dot */
    const char *dot = memchr(domain, '.', len);
    if(dot) {
      size_t i = dot - domain;
      if((len - i) > 1)
        /* the dot is not the last byte */
        return FALSE;
    }

  return TRUE;
}

/* RFC 6265 section 4.1.1 says a server should accept this range:

   Yet, Firefox and Chrome as of June 2022 accept space, comma and
   double-quotes fine. The prime reason for filtering out control bytes is that
   some HTTP servers return 400 for requests that contain such.

static bool invalid_octets(const char *ptr, size_t len)
{

    if((*p < 0x20) || (*p == 0x7f))
      return TRUE;
    p++;
    len--;

  return FALSE;
}

static bool parse_flag(struct Curl_easy *data, struct Cookie *co,
                       const struct CookieInfo *ci,

{

   * reading from file

      return FALSE;

  else if(curlx_str_casecompare(name, "httponly"))
    co->httponly = TRUE;

  return TRUE;

      break;

      if(strncmp("TRUE", ptr, len) && strncmp("FALSE", ptr, len)) {
        /* only if the path does not look like a boolean option! */

               co->name, co->domain ? co->domain : "[blank]",
               domain ? domain : "[file]"));

    return FALSE;

    char lcookie[256];

    size_t clen = strlen(co->domain);

          acceptable =
            curl_strequal(lcookie, "localhost") ||

  (void)co;
  (void)domain;
  DEBUGF(infof(data, "NO PSL to check set-cookie '%s' for domain=%s in %s",

/*

{

     and remove to lists while keeping the cookie struct intact */
  for(i = 0; i < COOKIE_HASH_SIZE; i++)
    Curl_llist_init(&ci->cookielist[i], NULL);
  /*

   * information yet.

  ci->next_expiration = CURL_OFF_T_MAX;

  return ci;

/*
 * cookie_sort
 *
 * Helper function to sort cookies such that the longest path gets before the
 * shorter path. Path, domain and name lengths are considered in that order,
 * with the creationtime as the tiebreaker. The creationtime is guaranteed to
 * be unique per cookie, so we know we will get an ordering at that point.
 */
static int cookie_sort(const void *p1, const void *p2)
{
  const struct Cookie *c1 = *(const struct Cookie * const *)p1;
  const struct Cookie *c2 = *(const struct Cookie * const *)p2;
  size_t l1, l2;

  /* 1 - compare cookie path lengths */
  l1 = c1->path ? strlen(c1->path) : 0;
  l2 = c2->path ? strlen(c2->path) : 0;

  if(l1 != l2)
    return (l2 > l1) ? 1 : -1; /* avoid size_t <=> int conversions */

  /* 2 - compare cookie domain lengths */

@B 1432 535
  l1 = c1->domain ? strlen(c1->domain) : 0;
  l2 = c2->domain ? strlen(c2->domain) : 0;

  if(l1 != l2)
    return (l2 > l1) ? 1 : -1; /* avoid size_t <=> int conversions */

  /* 3 - compare cookie name lengths */
  l1 = c1->name ? strlen(c1->name) : 0;
  l2 = c2->name ? strlen(c2->name) : 0;

  if(l1 != l2)
    return (l2 > l1) ? 1 : -1;

  /* 4 - compare cookie creation time */
  return (c2->creationtime > c1->creationtime) ? 1 : -1;
}

/*
 * cookie_sort_ct
 *
 * Helper function to sort cookies according to creation time.
 */

@B 1433 722
static int cookie_sort_ct(const void *p1, const void *p2)
{
  const struct Cookie *c1 = *(const struct Cookie * const *)p1;
  const struct Cookie *c2 = *(const struct Cookie * const *)p2;

  return (c2->creationtime > c1->creationtime) ? 1 : -1;
}

bool Curl_secure_context(struct Curl_easy *data, const char *host)
{
  return Curl_xfer_is_secure(data) ||
    curl_strequal("localhost", host) ||
    !strcmp(host, "127.0.0.1") ||
    !strcmp(host, "::1");
}

/*
 * get_netscape_format()
 *
 * Formats a string for Netscape output file, w/o a newline at the end.
 * Function returns a char * to a formatted line. The caller is responsible
 * for freeing the returned pointer.
 */
static char *get_netscape_format(const struct Cookie *co)
{
  return curl_maprintf(
    "%s"               /* httponly preamble */
    "%s%s\t"           /* domain */
    "%s\t"             /* tailmatch */
    "%s\t"             /* path */
    "%s\t"             /* secure */
    "%" FMT_OFF_T "\t" /* expires */
    "%s\t"             /* name */

@B 143a 673
    "%s",              /* value */
    co->httponly ? "#HttpOnly_" : "",
    /*
     * Make sure all domains are prefixed with a dot if they allow
     * tailmatching. This is Mozilla-style.
     */
    (co->tailmatch && co->domain && co->domain[0] != '.') ? "." : "",
    co->domain ? co->domain : "unknown",
    co->tailmatch ? "TRUE" : "FALSE",
    co->path ? co->path : "/",
    co->secure ? "TRUE" : "FALSE",
    co->expires,
    co->name,
    co->value ? co->value : "");
}

/*
 * cookie_output()
 *
 * Writes all internally known cookies to the specified file. Specify
 * "-" as filename to write to stdout.
 *
 * The function returns non-zero on write failure.
 */

@B 143b 994
static CURLcode cookie_output(struct Curl_easy *data,
                              struct CookieInfo *ci,
                              const char *filename)
{
  FILE *out = NULL;
  bool use_stdout = FALSE;
  char *tempstore = NULL;
  CURLcode result = CURLE_OK;

  if(!ci)
    /* no cookie engine alive */
    return CURLE_OK;

  /* at first, remove expired cookies */
  remove_expired(ci);

  if(!strcmp("-", filename)) {
    /* use stdout */
    out = stdout;
    use_stdout = TRUE;
  }
  else {
    result = Curl_fopen(data, filename, &out, &tempstore);
    if(result)
      goto error;
  }

  fputs("# Netscape HTTP Cookie File\n"
        "# https://curl.se/docs/http-cookies.html\n"
        "# This file was generated by libcurl! Edit at your own risk.\n\n",
        out);

  if(ci->numcookies) {
    unsigned int i;
    size_t nvalid = 0;
    struct Cookie **array;
    struct Curl_llist_node *n;

    array = curlx_calloc(1, sizeof(struct Cookie *) * ci->numcookies);
    if(!array) {

@B 143c 650
      result = CURLE_OUT_OF_MEMORY;
      goto error;
    }

    /* only sort the cookies with a domain property */
    for(i = 0; i < COOKIE_HASH_SIZE; i++) {
      for(n = Curl_llist_head(&ci->cookielist[i]); n; n = Curl_node_next(n)) {
        struct Cookie *co = Curl_node_elem(n);
        if(!co->domain)
          continue;
        array[nvalid++] = co;
      }
    }

    qsort(array, nvalid, sizeof(struct Cookie *), cookie_sort_ct);

    for(i = 0; i < nvalid; i++) {
      char *format_ptr = get_netscape_format(array[i]);
      if(!format_ptr) {
        curlx_free(array);
        result = CURLE_OUT_OF_MEMORY;
        goto error;
      }

@B 143d 1358
      curl_mfprintf(out, "%s\n", format_ptr);
      curlx_free(format_ptr);
    }

    curlx_free(array);
  }

  if(!use_stdout) {
    curlx_fclose(out);
    out = NULL;
    if(tempstore && curlx_rename(tempstore, filename)) {
      result = CURLE_WRITE_ERROR;
      goto error;
    }
  }

  /*
   * If we reach here we have successfully written a cookie file so there is
   * no need to inspect the error, any error case should have jumped into the
   * error block below.
   */
  curlx_free(tempstore);
  return CURLE_OK;

error:
  if(out && !use_stdout)
    curlx_fclose(out);
  if(tempstore) {
    unlink(tempstore);
    curlx_free(tempstore);
  }
  return result;
}

static struct curl_slist *cookie_list(const struct Curl_easy *data)
{
  struct curl_slist *list = NULL;
  struct curl_slist *beg;
  unsigned int i;
  struct Curl_llist_node *n;

  if(!data->cookies || (data->cookies->numcookies == 0))
    return NULL;

  /* at first, remove expired cookies */
  remove_expired(data->cookies);

  for(i = 0; i < COOKIE_HASH_SIZE; i++) {
    for(n = Curl_llist_head(&data->cookies->cookielist[i]); n;
        n = Curl_node_next(n)) {
      struct Cookie *c = Curl_node_elem(n);
      char *line;
      if(!c->domain)
        continue;
      line = get_netscape_format(c);
      if(!line) {
        curl_slist_free_all(list);
        return NULL;
      }

@B 143e 1772
      beg = Curl_slist_append_nodup(list, line);
      if(!beg) {
        curlx_free(line);
        curl_slist_free_all(list);
        return NULL;
      }
      list = beg;
    }
  }

  return list;
}

struct curl_slist *Curl_cookie_list(struct Curl_easy *data)
{
  struct curl_slist *list;
  Curl_share_lock(data, CURL_LOCK_DATA_COOKIE, CURL_LOCK_ACCESS_SINGLE);
  list = cookie_list(data);
  Curl_share_unlock(data, CURL_LOCK_DATA_COOKIE);
  return list;
}

void Curl_flush_cookies(struct Curl_easy *data, bool cleanup)
{
  Curl_share_lock(data, CURL_LOCK_DATA_COOKIE, CURL_LOCK_ACCESS_SINGLE);
  /* only save the cookie file if a transfer was started (cookies->running is
     set), as otherwise the cookies were not completely initialized and there
     might be cookie files that were not loaded so saving the file is the
     wrong thing. */
  if(data->cookies) {
    const char *cookiejar = CURL_EASY_STR(data, STRING_COOKIEJAR);
    if(cookiejar && data->cookies->running) {
      /* if we have a destination file for all the cookies to get dumped to */
      CURLcode result = cookie_output(data, data->cookies, cookiejar);
      if(result)
        infof(data, "WARNING: failed to save cookies in %s: %s",
              cookiejar, curl_easy_strerror(result));
    }

    if(cleanup && (!data->share || (data->cookies != data->share->cookies))) {
      Curl_cookie_cleanup(data->cookies);
      data->cookies = NULL;
    }
  }
  Curl_share_unlock(data, CURL_LOCK_DATA_COOKIE);
}

void Curl_cookie_run(struct Curl_easy *data)
{
  Curl_share_lock(data, CURL_LOCK_DATA_COOKIE, CURL_LOCK_ACCESS_SINGLE);
  if(data->cookies)
    data->cookies->running = TRUE;
  Curl_share_unlock(data, CURL_LOCK_DATA_COOKIE);
}

#endif /* CURL_DISABLE_HTTP || CURL_DISABLE_COOKIES */

    CHARACTER* pCharacter = g_EmpireGuardian1.CreateMonster(iType, PosX, PosY, Key);

        pCharacter->Object.Scale = 1.55f;

    case MONSTER_HEAD_MOUNTER:

        OpenMonsterModel(MONSTER_MODEL_HEAD_MOUNTER);
        pCharacter = CreateCharacter(Key, MODEL_HEAD_MOUNTER, PosX, PosY);
        pCharacter->Object.Scale = 1.25f;
    }
    break;

    default: return pCharacter;
    }

    return pCharacter;
}

}

void GMEmpireGuardian3::MoveBlurEffect(CHARACTER* c, OBJECT* o, BMD* b)
{
    switch (o->Type)
    {
    case MODEL_RAYMOND:
    case MODEL_DEFENDER:
    case MODEL_FORSAKER:
    case MODEL_OCELOT:
    case MODEL_ERIC:
    {
        g_EmpireGuardian1.MoveBlurEffect(c, o, b);
    }
    break;
    case MODEL_DUAL_BERSERKER:
    {
        vec3_t  Light;

@B 1ql8 8283
        vec3_t StartPos, StartRelative;
        vec3_t EndPos, EndRelative;
        float fActionSpeed, fSpeedPerFrame, fAnimationFrame;

        if (o->CurrentAction == MONSTER01_ATTACK1)
        {
            if (4.2f <= o->AnimationFrame && o->AnimationFrame < 6.6f)
            {
                Vector(0.9f, 0.5f, 0.4f, Light);

                fActionSpeed = b->Actions[o->CurrentAction].PlaySpeed * static_cast<float>(FPS_ANIMATION_FACTOR);
                fSpeedPerFrame = fActionSpeed / 5.f;
                fAnimationFrame = o->AnimationFrame - fActionSpeed;

                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
                {
                    b->Animation(BoneTransform, fAnimationFrame, o->PriorAnimationFrame, o->PriorAction, o->Angle, o->HeadAngle);

                    Vector(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, StartRelative);
                    Vector(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, EndRelative);

                    b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[24], StartRelative, StartPos, false);
                    b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[25], EndRelative, EndPos, false);
                    CreateBlur(c, StartPos, EndPos, Light, 2, false, 1);

                    fAnimationFrame += fSpeedPerFrame;
                }
            }
            else if (10.2f <= o->AnimationFrame && o->AnimationFrame < 12.6f)
            {
                Vector(0.9f, 0.5f, 0.4f, Light);

                fActionSpeed = b->Actions[o->CurrentAction].PlaySpeed * static_cast<float>(FPS_ANIMATION_FACTOR);;
                fSpeedPerFrame = fActionSpeed / 5.f;
                fAnimationFrame = o->AnimationFrame - fActionSpeed;

                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
                {
                    b->Animation(BoneTransform, fAnimationFrame, o->PriorAnimationFrame, o->PriorAction, o->Angle, o->HeadAngle);

                    Vector(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, StartRelative);
                    Vector(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, EndRelative);

                    b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[43], StartRelative, StartPos, false);
                    b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[44], EndRelative, EndPos, false);
                    CreateBlur(c, StartPos, EndPos, Light, 2, false, 0);
                    //b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[24], StartRelative, StartPos, false);
                    //b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[25], EndRelative, EndPos, false);
                    //CreateBlur(c, StartPos, EndPos, Light, 2, false, 1);

                    fAnimationFrame += fSpeedPerFrame;
                }
            }
        }
        else if (o->CurrentAction == MONSTER01_ATTACK2)
        {
            if (6.2f <= o->AnimationFrame && o->AnimationFrame < 8.2f)
            {
                Vector(0.9f, 0.5f, 0.4f, Light);

                fActionSpeed = b->Actions[o->CurrentAction].PlaySpeed * static_cast<float>(FPS_ANIMATION_FACTOR);;
                fSpeedPerFrame = fActionSpeed / 5.f;
                fAnimationFrame = o->AnimationFrame - fActionSpeed;
                for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
                {
                    b->Animation(BoneTransform, fAnimationFrame, o->PriorAnimationFrame, o->PriorAction, o->Angle, o->HeadAngle);

                    Vector(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, StartRelative);
                    Vector(0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f, EndRelative);

                    b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[43], StartRelative, StartPos, false);
                    b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[44], EndRelative, EndPos, false);
                    CreateBlur(c, StartPos, EndPos, Light, 2, false, 0);
                    b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[24], StartRelative, StartPos, false);
                    b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[25], EndRelative, EndPos, false);
                    CreateBlur(c, StartPos, EndPos, Light, 2, false, 1);

                    fAnimationFrame += fSpeedPerFrame;
                }
            }
        }
        else if (o->CurrentAction == MONSTER01_ATTACK3)

                fSpeedPerFrame = fActionSpeed / 10.f;
                fAnimationFrame = o->AnimationFrame - fActionSpeed;
                for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)

                    CreateBlur(c, StartPos, EndPos, Light, 2, false, 21);

                            b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[25], vRelative, vPosition, false);

@B 1ql9 1361

bool GMEmpireGuardian3::RenderObjectMesh(OBJECT* o, BMD* b, bool ExtraMon)
{

        return false;

    return false;
}

bool GMEmpireGuardian3::RenderObjectVisual(OBJECT* o, BMD* b)
{
    if (gMapManager.IsEmpireGuardian3() == false)
        return false;

    vec3_t p, Position, Light;
    Vector(0.f, 30.f, 0.f, Position);
    Vector(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, p);

    switch (o->Type)

@B 1qlb 6065
    {
    case 12:
    {
        vec3_t vPos, vRelativePos, vLight1, vLight2;
        float flumi = absf(sinf(WorldTime * 0.0008)) * 0.9f + 0.1f;
        float fScale = o->Scale * 0.3f * flumi;
        Vector(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, vPos);
        Vector(8.f, -3.f, -3.f, vRelativePos);
        Vector(flumi, flumi, flumi, vLight1);
        Vector(0.9f, 0.1f, 0.1f, vLight2);
        b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[2], vRelativePos, vPos);
#ifdef LDS_FIX_ACCESS_INDEXNUMBER_ALREADY_LOADTEXTURE
        CreateSprite(BITMAP_SHINY + 6, vPos, 0.5f, vLight2, o);
        CreateSprite(BITMAP_SHINY + 6, vPos, fScale, vLight1, o);
        Vector(3.f, -3.f, -3.5f, vRelativePos);
        b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[3], vRelativePos, vPos);
        CreateSprite(BITMAP_SHINY + 6, vPos, 0.5f, vLight2, o);
        CreateSprite(BITMAP_SHINY + 6, vPos, fScale, vLight1, o);
#else // LDS_FIX_ACCESS_INDEXNUMBER_ALREADY_LOADTEXTURE
        CreateSprite(BITMAP_SHINY + 5, vPos, 0.5f, vLight2, o);
        CreateSprite(BITMAP_SHINY + 5, vPos, fScale, vLight1, o);
        Vector(3.f, -3.f, -3.5f, vRelativePos);
        b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[3], vRelativePos, vPos);
        CreateSprite(BITMAP_SHINY + 5, vPos, 0.5f, vLight2, o);
        CreateSprite(BITMAP_SHINY + 5, vPos, fScale, vLight1, o);
#endif // LDS_FIX_ACCESS_INDEXNUMBER_ALREADY_LOADTEXTURE
    }
    return true;
    case 20:
    {
        if (o->AnimationFrame > 5.4f && o->AnimationFrame < 6.5f)
        {
            vec3_t	Angle;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
            {
                Vector((float)(rand() % 60 + 60 + 90), 0.f, o->Angle[2] + 180, Angle);
                CreateJointFpsChecked(BITMAP_JOINT_SPARK, o->Position, o->Position, Angle, 5, o);
            }
            CreateParticleFpsChecked(BITMAP_SPARK, o->Position, Angle, o->Light, 11);
        }
        else if (o->AnimationFrame > 15.4f && o->AnimationFrame < 16.5f)
        {
            vec3_t	Angle;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
            {
                Vector((float)(rand() % 60 + 60 + 90), 0.f, o->Angle[2], Angle);
                CreateJointFpsChecked(BITMAP_JOINT_SPARK, o->Position, o->Position, Angle, 5, o);
            }
            CreateParticleFpsChecked(BITMAP_SPARK, o->Position, Angle, o->Light, 11);
        }
    }
    return true;

    case 37:
    {
        Vector(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, p);
        b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[1], p, Position);

        float fLumi;
        fLumi = (sinf(WorldTime * 0.039f) + 1.0f) * 0.2f + 0.6f;
        vec3_t vLightFire;
        Vector(fLumi * 0.7f, fLumi * 0.7f, fLumi * 0.7f, vLightFire);
        CreateSprite(BITMAP_FLARE, Position, 4.0f * o->Scale, vLightFire, o);
    }
    return true;

    case 50:
    {
        vec3_t vPos, vRelativePos, vLight1, vLight2, vAngle;
        Vector(0.f, 0.f, 0.f, vPos);
        Vector(0.f, 0.f, 5.f, vRelativePos);
        Vector(0.0f, -1.0f, 0.0f, vAngle);
        Vector(0.05f, 0.1f, 0.3f, vLight1);
        Vector(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, vLight2);

        for (int i = 2; i <= 7; i++)
        {
            b->TransformPosition(BoneTransform[i], vRelativePos, vPos);
            CreateParticleFpsChecked(BITMAP_FIRE_HIK3_MONO, vPos, vAngle, vLight1, 4, o->Scale * 0.6f);
            CreateParticleFpsChecked(BITMAP_FIRE_HIK3_MONO, vPos, vAngle, vLight2, 4, o->Scale * 0.3f);
        }
    }
    return true;

    case 51:
    {
        if (o->AnimationFrame > 5.4f && o->AnimationFrame < 6.5f)
        {
            vec3_t	Angle;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
            {
                Vector((float)(rand() % 60 + 60 + 90), 0.f, o->Angle[2] + 180, Angle);
                CreateJointFpsChecked(BITMAP_JOINT_SPARK, o->Position, o->Position, Angle, 5, o);
            }
            CreateParticleFpsChecked(BITMAP_SPARK, o->Position, Angle, o->Light, 11);
        }
    }
    return true;

    case 64:
    {
        if ((o->AnimationFrame > 9.5f && o->AnimationFrame < 11.5f) ||
            (o->AnimationFrame > 23.5f && o->AnimationFrame < 25.5f))
        {
            float Matrix[3][4];
            vec3_t vAngle, vDirection, vPosition;
            Vector(0.f, 0.f, o->Angle[2] + 90, vAngle);
            AngleMatrix(vAngle, Matrix);
            Vector(0.f, 30.0f, 0.f, vDirection);
            VectorRotate(vDirection, Matrix, vPosition);
            VectorAdd(vPosition, o->Position, Position);

            Vector(0.04f, 0.03f, 0.02f, Light);
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
            {
                CreateParticleFpsChecked(BITMAP_CLOUD, Position, o->Angle, Light, 22, o->Scale, o);
            }
        }
    }
    return true;

    case 79:
    {
        vec3_t vLightFire;
        Vector(1.0f, 0.2f, 0.0f, vLightFire);
        CreateSprite(BITMAP_LIGHT, o->Position, 2.0f * o->Scale, vLightFire, o);

        vec3_t vLight;
        Vector(1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, vLight);

        switch (rand() % 3)
        {
        case 0:
            CreateParticleFpsChecked(BITMAP_FIRE_HIK1, o->Position, o->Angle, vLight, 0, o->Scale);
            break;
        case 1:
            CreateParticleFpsChecked(BITMAP_FIRE_CURSEDLICH, o->Position, o->Angle, vLight, 4, o->Scale);
            break;
        case 2:
            CreateParticleFpsChecked(BITMAP_FIRE_HIK3, o->Position, o->Angle, vLight, 0, o->Scale);
            break;
        }
    }
    return true;
    case 80:
    {
        float fLumi;
        fLumi = (sinf(WorldTime * 0.04f) + 1.0f) * 0.3f + 0.4f;
        vec3_t vLightFire;
        Vector(fLumi * 0.1f, fLumi * 0.1f, fLumi * 0.5f, vLightFire);
        CreateSprite(BITMAP_LIGHT, o->Position, 8.0f * o->Scale, vLightFire, o);
    }
    return true;
    case 82:
    {
        CreateParticleFpsChecked(BITMAP_WATERFALL_5, o->Position, o->Angle, Light, 9, o->Scale);
    }
    return true;

    case 83:
    {
        Vector(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, Light);
        CreateParticleFpsChecked(BITMAP_WATERFALL_3, o->Position, o->Angle, Light, 14, o->Scale);
    }
    return true;

    case 84:
    {
        Vector(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, Light);
        if (rand_fps_check(8))

@B 1qlc 1324
        {
            CreateParticle(BITMAP_WATERFALL_2, o->Position, o->Angle, Light, 4, o->Scale);
        }
    }
    return true;

    case 85:
    {
        vec3_t vLight;
        Vector(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f, vLight);
        int iWorldTime = (int)WorldTime;
        int iRemainder = iWorldTime % 200;

        if (iRemainder >= 0 && iRemainder <= 1)
        {
            int iRand = rand() % 4 + 4;
            for (int i = 0; i < iRand; ++i)
            {
                CreateEffectFpsChecked(BITMAP_FLAME, o->Position, o->Angle, vLight, 6, NULL, -1, 0, o->Scale);
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
    case 86:
    {
        if (rand_fps_check(6))
        {
            Vector(0.05f, 0.02f, 0.01f, Light);
            CreateParticle(BITMAP_CLOUD, o->Position, o->Angle, Light, 21, o->Scale, o);
        }
    }
    return true;
    case 129:
    {
        if (rand_fps_check(6))
        {
            Vector(0.01f, 0.02f, 0.05f, Light);
            CreateParticle(BITMAP_CLOUD, o->Position, o->Angle, Light, 21, o->Scale, o);
        }
    }
    return true;
    case 130:
    {
        if (rand_fps_check(6))
        {
            Vector(0.01f, 0.05f, 0.02f, Light);
            CreateParticle(BITMAP_CLOUD, o->Position, o->Angle, Light, 21, o->Scale, o);
        }
    }
    return true;
    case 131:

@B 1qld 1155
    {
        if (rand_fps_check(3))
        {
            Vector(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, Light);
            CreateParticle(BITMAP_SMOKE, o->Position, o->Angle, Light, 22, o->Scale);

            Vector(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, Light);
            CreateParticle(BITMAP_SMOKE, o->Position, o->Angle, Light, 21, o->Scale * 2.0f, o);
        }
    }
    return true;
    case 132:
    {
        if (rand_fps_check(3))
        {
            Vector(1.f, 1.f, 1.f, Light);

bool SDL_ChannelMapIsBogus(const int *chmap, int channels)
{

            }
        }
    }
    return false;

bool SDL_ChannelMapIsDefault(const int *chmap, int channels)

// Calculate the largest frame size needed to convert between the two formats.
static int CalculateMaxFrameSize(SDL_AudioFormat src_format, int src_channels, SDL_AudioFormat dst_format, int dst_channels)
{
    const int src_format_size = SDL_AUDIO_BYTESIZE(src_format);
    const int dst_format_size = SDL_AUDIO_BYTESIZE(dst_format);
    const int max_app_format_size = SDL_max(src_format_size, dst_format_size);
    const int max_format_size = SDL_max(max_app_format_size, sizeof (float));  // ConvertAudio and ResampleAudio use floats.
    const int max_channels = SDL_max(src_channels, dst_channels);
    return max_format_size * max_channels;
}

    if ((resample_rate == 0x100000000) && (resample_offset == 0)) {
        resample_rate = 0;
    }

    return resample_rate;
}

static bool UpdateAudioStreamInputSpec(SDL_AudioStream *stream, const SDL_AudioSpec *spec, const int *chmap)
{
    if (SDL_AudioSpecsEqual(&stream->input_spec, spec, stream->input_chmap, chmap)) {
        return true;
    }

    if (!SDL_ResetAudioQueueHistory(stream->queue, SDL_GetResamplerHistoryFrames())) {
        return false;
    }

    if (!chmap) {
        stream->input_chmap = NULL;
    } else {
        const size_t chmaplen = sizeof (*chmap) * spec->channels;
        stream->input_chmap = stream->input_chmap_storage;
        SDL_memcpy(stream->input_chmap, chmap, chmaplen);
    }

    SDL_copyp(&stream->input_spec, spec);

    return true;
}

{

}

{

        return SDL_SetError("Stream has no source format");

        return SDL_SetError("Stream has no destination format");
